verdict: Leads surged 83% week-over-week; Google spend efficiency needs rebalancing now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 36 leads at an average cost of $105.14 per lead, with Meta driving all 36 of those leads at $50.99 each. Google Ads, by contrast, produced 2 conversions at roughly $975 per lead on nearly identical spend — a 19x gap that confirms budget needs to shift toward Meta. That reallocation is in motion now. On the pipeline side, 105 opportunities have been created from 320 contacts with none yet converted, which points to an intake process gap rather than an ads issue — we're focused on closing that loop. Next period, expect a lower blended cost per lead as Google spend is reduced and Meta volume is prioritized.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta — up 83% from the prior week
cost per lead on Meta, versus roughly $975 on Google Ads this same period
pipeline opportunities created from 320 contacts this period — conversion follow-through is being addressed

watch_item.issue: Zero pipeline conversions from 105 open opportunities — leads are arriving but not advancing to signed clients.
watch_item.fix: Intake and follow-up workflows are being reviewed and tightened so incoming leads are contacted and moved through the pipeline faster.
